summary: The focused boundary-marker obligation is supported by the changed normalizer, but the supplied evidence does not establish whether the old harness can reach it through utf8proc_map.
missing_information: The before and after utf8proc_map call path, including helpers that create boundary markers and reencode the result.
The definitions of UTF8PROC_CHARBOUND and UTF8PROC_STRIPCC.
The delegated test/ossfuzz.sh build recipe and any flags it sets.

claims.necessity_reason: The after normalizer supports the frozen marker behavior, and the old harness has no visible map call combining CHARBOUND and STRIPCC. The missing flag definitions and map path prevent ruling out an equivalent route.

before.requirement: During utf8proc_map, retain the boundary marker before surviving text while removing the marker immediately before a stripped control.
before.reason: The before normalizer treats a negative boundary marker as a control under STRIPCC and removes it, so this tuple is unsupported there.

after.requirement: With CHARBOUND and STRIPCC combined during utf8proc_map, retain the marker before surviving text and remove the marker immediately before a stripped control.
after.reason: The changed normalizer preserves negative markers and removes a preceding marker when it strips a control. The added test exercises the combined map flags. The old harness does not visibly combine those flags in a map call, but reachability through its existing calls cannot be settled without the flag definitions and complete map path.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The added test demonstrates the combined mapping behavior and a two-step equivalent route.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The entry guards and NUL-terminated input handling determine whether a finite control-character witness can reach the map calls.
The supplied build recipe delegates target construction to an unsupplied script.

claims.comparison_reason: The same marker retention and removal tuple is assessed against the same old harness. The before normalizer removes negative markers under STRIPCC; the after normalizer retains them and can remove the marker before a stripped control.
missing_information: Complete before and after utf8proc_map and delegated decomposition and reencoding paths.
test/ossfuzz.sh and any configuration it delegates.
